answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 2104 Country: India Title: Chaadar poshi on mazaar is right or wrong .should we go to mazaar of saints like nizamuddin and moinuddin chishti rahmatullah etc? Question: Chaadar poshi on mazaar is right or wrong .should we go to mazaar of saints like nizamuddin and moinuddin chishti rahmatullah etc? Answer ID: 2104 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 540/540=L) Chaadar poshi (covering grave with sheet) is innovation (bidaÂ’h) and thus unlawful: تکرہ الستور علی القبور (شامی: 3/145، ط زکریا دیوبند) There is nothing wrong in visiting to the graves of pious people, but one should go there according to sunnah and return after fatiha and isaal-e-sawab (conveying the reward). It is haram to invoke their mercy in ones needs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
